scripts.test:application:unit: python scripts/repo_run.py pytest application/python/tests -q -m "not integration and not docker"
scripts.test:core:integration: python scripts/repo_run.py pytest core/python/tests -m "integration and not api and not slow_integration" -q
scripts.test:application:integration: python scripts/repo_run.py pytest application/python/tests -m "integration and not api and not slow_integration and not docker" -q
scripts.test:ollama: python scripts/repo_run.py pytest core/python/tests -m "ollama and not api" -q
scripts.test:api:examples: python scripts/repo_run.py pytest core/python/examples/tests -m "integration and api and not slow_integration" -q
scripts.test:api:application: python scripts/repo_run.py pytest application/python/tests -m "integration and api and not slow_integration and not docker" -q
scripts.test:api:openrouter: python scripts/repo_run.py pytest plugins/openrouter/tests -m "integration and api and not slow_integration and openrouter" -q
scripts.test:api:openai: python scripts/repo_run.py pytest plugins/openai_responses/tests -m "integration and api and not slow_integration and openai" -q
scripts.test:api:fireworks: python scripts/repo_run.py pytest plugins/reference-openai-compatible-provider/tests -m "integration and api and not slow_integration and fireworks" -q
scripts.test:api:zai: python scripts/repo_run.py pytest plugins/reference-openai-compatible-provider/tests -m "integration and api and not slow_integration and zai" -q

scripts.lint: python scripts/repo_run.py ruff check core/python/agent_core core/python/tests core/python/examples core/python/plugins
scripts.lint:fix: python scripts/repo_run.py ruff check --fix core/python/agent_core core/python/tests core/python/examples core/python/plugins
scripts.format: python scripts/repo_run.py black core/python/agent_core core/python/tests core/python/examples core/python/plugins
scripts.mobile:ios:testflight:start: gh workflow run ios-testflight.yml -r main -f upload_to_testflight=true
scripts.mobile:ios:testflight:watch: gh run watch "$(gh run list -w ios-testflight.yml -b main -L 1 --json databaseId -q '.[0].databaseId')" --exit-status
scripts.roadmap:release:status: python scripts/repo_run.py python roadmaps/sync.py status release
scripts.roadmap:release:push: python scripts/repo_run.py python roadmaps/sync.py push release
scripts.roadmap:release:push:write: python scripts/repo_run.py python roadmaps/sync.py push release --write
scripts.roadmap:release:pull: python scripts/repo_run.py python roadmaps/sync.py pull release
scripts.roadmap:release:pull:write: python scripts/repo_run.py python roadmaps/sync.py pull release --write
scripts.roadmap:release:update: npm run roadmap:release:generate && npm run roadmap:release:push:write
scripts.roadmap:release:verify: npm run roadmap:release:check && npm run roadmap:release:test && npm run roadmap:release:status && npm run roadmap:release:pull
scripts.roadmap:product:status: python scripts/repo_run.py python roadmaps/sync.py status product
scripts.roadmap:product:push: python scripts/repo_run.py python roadmaps/sync.py push product
scripts.roadmap:product:push:write: python scripts/repo_run.py python roadmaps/sync.py push product --write
scripts.roadmap:product:pull: python scripts/repo_run.py python roadmaps/sync.py pull product
scripts.roadmap:product:pull:write: python scripts/repo_run.py python roadmaps/sync.py pull product --write
scripts.roadmap:product:update: npm run roadmap:product:generate && npm run roadmap:product:push:write
scripts.roadmap:product:verify: npm run roadmap:product:check && npm run roadmap:product:test && npm run roadmap:product:status && npm run roadmap:product:pull
scripts.install:all: python scripts/repo_run.py python -m pip install -e "core/python[dev]" -e application/python
scripts.install:app: python scripts/repo_run.py python -m pip install -e application/python
scripts.install:plugins: python scripts/repo_run.py python -m pip install -e "plugins/kimi-tools[dev]" -e "plugins/claude-tools[dev]" && python scripts/repo_run.py python -m pip install -e "plugins/tool-compat-shared[dev]" -e "plugins/web-fetch-shared[dev]" -e "plugins/openai_responses[dev]"
scripts.deploy:bridge: rsync -av --exclude '_build' --exclude 'deps' bridge-elixir/ ireland-s1.dynamicprogrammingsolutions.com:~/bridge-elixir/ && ssh ireland-s1.dynamicprogrammingsolutions.com 'cd ~/bridge-elixir && docker-compose -f docker-compose.single-node-v2.yml build && docker-compose -f docker-compose.single-node-v2.yml up -d'
